mapper.select: SELECT t.* FROM sys_tenant t INNER JOIN sys_tenant_package tenant_package ON tenant_package.id = t.package_id AND tenant_package.deleted = 0 AND tenant_package.status = 0 WHERE t.id = #{tenantId} AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 0 AND (t.expire_time IS NULL OR t.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

SELECT t.id, t.tenant_code, t.company_name FROM sys_tenant t INNER JOIN sys_tenant_package tenant_package ON tenant_package.id = t.package_id AND tenant_package.deleted = 0 AND tenant_package.status = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 0 AND (t.expire_time IS NULL OR t.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY t.company_name, t.id

SELECT t.id FROM sys_tenant t INNER JOIN sys_tenant_package tenant_package ON tenant_package.id = t.package_id AND tenant_package.deleted = 0 AND tenant_package.status = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 0 AND (t.expire_time IS NULL OR t.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
